reviewed_key_policy: For addon-owned full locales, use exact target English for the seven added keys and changed recipeBack meaning unless an exact already-validated semantic translation exists. None is assumed. For upstream supplement locales, emit target English only when one of these reviewed keys is actually missing upstream.
reuse_rule: Reuse G7 translations exactly for the 85 unchanged key/value pairs. Do not carry the removed itemDescription key.
supplement_reuse_policy: Filter the deterministic G7 supplement down to target keys that remain missing upstream. For target missing keys that are new/changed in G8 or were not in a G7 supplement, use exact target English fallback.
debug_keys: Keep target English values for debug-only description.jei.* entries in full addon files; never add debug-only keys to supplements.
norwegian_policy: Minecraft-facing no_no remains a full addon locale. JEI nb_no is preserved independently and is not treated as an alias.
release_rule: Minecraft 1.11.2 must receive its own dedicated JAR; never combine it with Minecraft 1.11 or another version.
